verdict.rationale: Evidence shows sign-in flows such as browser-flow authentication service accounts and API keys tied to a Cursor account and Cloud Agents and CLI are documented as available across plans implying the coding agent is unlocked simply by signing into an existing paid Cursor subscription rather than a separate purchase. However there is no explicit documentation stating sign in with your existing plan to use the agent or clarifying tier by tier inclusion and limits. missing for 10: explicit statement that signing in with an existing subscription unlocks the agent without extra purchase, tier-by-tier feature and limit breakdown, independent corroboration of this sign-in-to-agent flow
